title: Track Mix 3-Mix Duo #19 (임산부 세로 띠·매끈 / 일반 가로 띠·물결 | 이레즈미+인어비늘+목재 / 나비날개비늘+흑요암금+금박)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each from a different look, each with her own multi-material blended body.

#1: Pakistani, in her late 20s, sultry expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust, and an extremely sharply cinched waist still visible at her sides even as a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects forward prominently from the centre of that narrow waistline — the dramatic waist-to-hip contrast still reading clearly around the belly's own round curve. Enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than the narrow waist. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, gold-dust eyeshadow, a deep maroon lip, richly detailed bridal makeup, warm brown skin, soft rose-gold hair styled in a classic French braid from the crown, real pores, real living eyes, 25 clicker rings piercings set with pearls in brass-toned metal, wearing well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of gold a hair ornament. Fused with 3 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 vertical bands by 2 hazy transition zones centred about 35% of the way across her figure from her left edge and about 75% of the way across her figure from her left edge. Region 1 is everything to her left of the first transition zone: it carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, hannya mask formations in CRIMSON and STARK GOLD, extreme high-gloss oil finish. Region 2 is the strip between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries mermaid scales (fine delicate scales, small and closely overlapping with a soft iridescent sheen), BLAZING ELECTRIC TEAL scale formations, VIVID SILVER scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 3 is everything to her right of the last transition zone: it carries rich reddish mahogany wood fused directly into her own form, natural fine grain lines flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING deep red-brown grain with VIVID copper highlight streaks. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. The materials of every region curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: standing frontal, both hands cradling the underside of her belly, chin level, calm commanding presence, her extreme platform high heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: Japanese, in her late 30s, sultry expression, warm radiant skin tone — an enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, luminous glossy skin with a bright highlighter, thick black eyeliner, extremely long dramatic false lashes top and bottom, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy peach-pink lips, a confident sparkling expression, rich chocolate-brown hair styled in a mohawk with volume along the centre of the scalp, real pores, real living eyes, 50 segment rings piercings set with opals in silver-toned metal, wearing a single piece of rose-gold a ring. Fused with 3 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 horizontal bands by 2 hazy transition zones centred about 20% of the way down her figure from the top and about 41% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it carries butterfly scales (thousands of microscopic powder-fine scales layered like overlapping roof tiles, each scale individually distinct catching its own glint), BLAZING ELECTRIC BLUE scale formations, VIVID DEEP BLACK scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries polished obsidian stone fused directly to her own form, solid glossy black stone curving to follow her body's true shape, with molten gold seams running between fitted stone sections. Region 3 is everything below the last transition zone: it carries applied ELECTRIC VIOLET leaf, thin irregular metallic sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, VIVID CYAN undertone glinting through the thinnest points. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her whole figure, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip, her extreme platform square-toe heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
